title: Oral Intervention of Narirutin Ameliorates the Allergic Response of Ovalbumin Allergy.
authors: Shi, Xiaolei; Zhao, Lina; Niu, Liyan; Yan, Yixuan; Chen, Qiushi; Jin, Yongri; Li, Xuwen
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柚皮苷对卵清蛋白过敏的口服耐受干预，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A new intervention was investigated for the induction of oral tolerance (OT) of OVA using narirutin by in vivo and in vitro experiments combined with network pharmacology and structural analysis of molecular docking. Narirutin (and its metabolism naringenin) has effects on OT by affecting B cell function, DCs, and T cell response by prediction. It was verified that narirutin could affect B cell function of secreting antibodies, thereby reducing the ability of DCs to absorb antigens by affecting GATA3, CCR7, STAT5, and MHCII expression and regulating T cell response by suppressing Th2 and improving Treg cells in vivo. Molecular docking showed that steric hindrance effects may be the reason for weaker binding energy with targets of narirutin. However, this does not mean that it has no bioactivity, for it can inhibit mast cell degranulation. This finding is interesting because it offers the possibility of using natural compounds to promote oral tolerance.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过体内外实验，结合网络药理学和分子对接结构分析，探讨了一种利用narirutin诱导OVA口服耐受（OT）的新干预方法。预测表明，narirutin（及其代谢物naringenin）通过影响B细胞功能、树突状细胞（DCs）和T细胞反应，对OT产生作用。实验验证了narirutin能够影响B细胞分泌抗体的功能，从而通过调节GATA3、CCR7、STAT5和MHCII表达，降低DCs吸收抗原的能力，并通过抑制Th2细胞和改善Treg细胞来调控体内T细胞反应。分子对接显示，空间位阻效应可能是narirutin与靶点结合能较弱的原因。然而，这并不意味着其无生物活性，因为它能抑制肥大细胞脱颗粒。这一发现颇具意义，因为它为利用天然化合物促进口服耐受提供了可能性。
